set.body:
Outcome: one generic live study command using an existing model transport, durable recordings, bounded attempts and interrupted-run resume; an offline command reproduces mapping records and predictions without model calls.
Scope: provider-agent text exchanges and pipeline agentmapping command/render path; authored synthetic inputs only. No corpus model run, new scientific claims, or provider dependency.
Invariants: legacy text-exchange/v1 replay remains exact. New configurable calls use a new key domain binding backend/model/system/prompt/token budget and endpoint configuration identity. Record before exposing success; fail closed on corrupt/uncertain state. A completed recording is reused on resume. Usage is provider-reported; client invocations are distinguished from internal HTTP attempt bounds. Live mode requires existing explicit authorization. Offline mode needs no credentials/client.
Relevant paths: provider-agent ModelExchange.scala, TextExchange.scala, Recordings.scala, AgentCredentials.scala, OpenAiCompatibleModelClient.scala; pipeline agentmapping StudyReplay.scala, StudyReplayCli.scala, StudyBundle.scala and a shared run command.
Acceptance: real loopback HTTP transport court with synthetic study, malformed reply retry, interruption/resume, changed config refusal, corrupt recordings, uncertain sent-but-unrecorded refusal, exact offline mapping equivalence and zero calls; targeted provider and pipeline tests plus scoped gate/format, independent exact-SHA review. Real-model smoke depends on provider configuration requested from owner.
Next action: complete identity/resume design review, claim narrow paths, implement integrated path and meaningful courts.
set.title: Live study execution with durable recording, bounded retries and offline replay
